entries.title: Join by its address works the first time you open Infinitary on a new computer
entries.body: When you opened Infinitary on a new computer, Join by its address always said it could not ask the other computer for a link. Now it signs in to the computer your first mate is on, asks for its link and joins it, as Paste its link does.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new is drawn: Join by its address now reaches the question it already asks on other launches, in place of the warning line.
